concept.title: Drift Mode (For GT)
concept.shortdesc: Drift Mode is a driving mode that automatically activates rear wheels (2WD) and brakes or Electronic Limited Slip Differential (e-LSD) to easily achieve drift with a small steering wheel angle and accelerator pedal.

section.title: Activating Drift Mode

li.p: Pull and hold the both side of the paddle shifter for more than approximately 3 seconds at the same time to switch to Drift Mode.
When Drift Mode is activated, Drift Mode activated warning message and DRIFT indicator will appear on the instrument cluster.

section.p: To activate the Drift Mode, satisfy all the following conditions:

li.p: ESC OFF is in state 2 (Press and hold the ESC OFF button for approximately 3–5 seconds)
The vehicle is in SPORT or GT mode
Engaging the brake pedal to the bottom

section.title: Deactivating Drift Mode
section.p: Drift Mode will be canceled or limited when:

li.p: If the DRIVE MODE is changed to a mode other than SPORT or GT mode during Drift Mode operation
ESC OFF is not in state 2
Pull and hold the both side of the paddle shifter for more than approximately 3 seconds at the same time during Drift Mode operation
Power down indicator () or service warning indicator () is illuminated
The ESC or e-LSD indicator is illuminated
